description:
Why roadsurfer?

  • TEAMSPIRIT & TEAMEVENTS: Look forward to a collegial atmosphere with flat hierarchies, lots of fun and great team spirit, as well as regular team events such as joint sports sessions, barbecues or just an after-work drink at your station.

  • CAMPER BUDGET: You get an annual camper budget to experience the #happyroadsurfing lifestyle for yourself.

  • DISCOUNTS: Use our Coverflex and Family & Friends Discounts.

The role - your passion

  • You are the sparring partner for leaders and the contact person for employees in our HQ departments – across the full lifecycle, from hiring to exit.

  • You empower our managers to own their hiring: you set up lean processes, sharpen their interview skills and step in where it matters, from needs clarification to offers.

  • You enable, coach and challenge our leaders to grow into strong role models for their teams – and guide them through difficult situations such as performance plans and exits.

  • You drive our AI-first way of working in HR: you use AI tools and automations every day, spot new use cases and build them into our processes.

What you need to surf the wave with us

  • 5+ years in HR with experience in both recruiting and People/HR Business Partnering, across the full employee lifecycle.

  • Confidence coaching leaders and handling complex cases, ideally in multi-country settings.

  • Knowledge of labour law in different countries is a plus.

  • You already use AI tools actively in your HR work and enjoy finding new ways to automate and simplify.

  • You thrive in a fast-changing company, get up to speed quickly and guide leaders and teams through change.

  • A structured way of working, empathy and a proactive, team-oriented mindset.

  • Business fluent English & German.

Your Salary

We ❤️ transparency. The salary range for this position is between 36,000 EUR and 46,000 EUR gross per year. We are currently introducing salary bands in our job descriptions to ensure that all employees are treated fairly. Once we get to know each other better during the application process and can assess your skills and experience more precisely, we will work together to determine which level within the salary band is the best fit for you.

 

Ready to surf?

We look forward to receiving your application! This is a fixed-term position for ca. 1 year to cover a parental leave. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us at team@roadsurfer.com, and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

ABOUT #ROADSURFER

roadsurfer was founded in Munich in 2016 by five friends who wanted to make campervan travel easier. What started with 25 VW California vans has grown into the global leader in campervan and motorhome adventures, with 10,000+ vehicles at around 100 stations across Europe and North America. Travellers can rent, subscribe to or buy a campervan and hit the road their way. Behind it all are 1,000+ people in our offices and stations, working together towards one goal: creating unforgettable outdoor memories. Built on a culture of trust, openness and ownership, roadsurfer gives you room to grow and see the difference you make every day. Ready to ride the wave with us?
